setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Reached through a nice transition from the opening jam, placed unusually early in the first set; Traditional folk music jam leads into this song in a strong intro [18][19]
- **Dead join Hamza** (1 other source): This version includes the entire Hamza opener [1]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer finds Donna's wailing nearly unbearable during this song [19]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): The band stumbles just before the 'sun comin up' lyrics in this song [13]
- **Around And Around** (1 other source): Final portion of the song, from 5:46 to the end, was supplied from another source [3]
- **Ollin Arrageed** (1 review): Opening track runs over half an hour: Hamza el-Din's band, then Jerry and Phil join, then everyone; Jerry shines [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-09-14.aud.dauria.2054.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 177 min [1]. Said about its sound: Microphones were hidden behind a cotton headpiece, so levels may sound muffled in places [1]
- **gd78-09-14.aud.dauria.6032.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 198 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sound is tolerable, better than many of the reviewer's early tapes [13]
- **gd1978-09-14.sbd.miller.88171.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 178 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Pitch correction was applied using Cool Edit Pro; disc changes are seamless [3]
- **gd78-09-14.sbd.miller.22169.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 180 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard from the master reel; hiss barely noticeable, vocals not prominent; Soundboard quality is really good for 1978 [15][19]
- **gd1978-09-14.165792.acetboy.remaster.flac1644**: audience recording; 18 songs; 152 min [5]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Hamza El-Din [1]
- Reviewer casts the Gizah pyramids setting as a mystical vortex channeling ancient wisdom through Hamza el Din and the band [9]
- Keith was made to audition for his job, played synths, and Donna is barely audible [13]
- Reviewer hears many band tears and dropouts, as if musicians struggled to hear each other [17]
- Attendee teaching in Alexandria recalls a lunar eclipse at the start while Egyptian drummers and chanters performed [20]
- Drums began, then Phil joined on bass before the band moved into their set [20]
- Attendee remembers Garcia playing extremely well and Weir being outstanding [20]
- Hamza El Din is credited with vocals and percussion [5]
- Reviewer says only the last Egypt night rivals other 1978 Dead shows; the first two nights are sloppy and below average [10]
- Reviewer found it better than the harsh reviews of this run suggested, despite the challenges of playing so far from home [11]
- Reviewer finds it only a middling show, perhaps due to nerves and disorientation, but interesting [15]
- The Dead played the Ollin Arrageed jam several times during Fall 1978 [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-09-14.aud.dauria.2054.shnf**: taped by The Face; transferred by John D'Auria; source: Aud FOB, front row LFC, Sony ECM280 > Sony TC-153 cassette recorder > Sony TC-640 reel to reel [1]
- **gd78-09-14.aud.dauria.6032.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by John D'Auria; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM280 [2]. Also: Taped front-of-board, front row, with Sony ECM280 mics into a Sony TC-153 cassette recorder; Transfer chain: cassettes through Yamaha deck, Apogee AD1000, Delta DiO 2496, Samplitude, to SHN; one fewer generation than before [2]
- **gd1978-09-14.sbd.miller.88171.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe B. Jones; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) [3]. Also: Source is a front-row cassette master from Sony ECM280 mics, transferred to CD [3]
- **gd78-09-14.sbd.miller.22169.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1978-09-14.165792.acetboy.remaster.flac1644**: source: remaster of shn #103626 (MOTB version of Eldon Porray audience)by acetboy [5]. Also: Remaster of an earlier shn, done in ocenaudio and Harrison Mixbus, delivered at CD quality [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Adrian Boot: [1978-09-16 Giza Sound and Light Theater, Cairo, Egypt - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-09-16-giza-sound-and-light-theater-cairo-egypt/) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Poster - Giza Sound and Light Theater](https://www.dead.net/archives/1978/artwork/poster-giza-sound-and-light-theater) [23]
